edits.intent: Deficiency: the two reserved crossover slots yield the weakest and only failing candidates in the current roster - rank_minus pairs carry |IC| 0.0171 and 0.0103 while every mutation and raw candidate is at least 0.0245, and turnover_mean_20 minus momentum_20 is the single failure (abs_icir_below_threshold, ICIR 0.0542). Semantics: crossover slots are reserved before mutations and raw-seed padding, so 0 should release both. Mechanism: released slots fall to raw padding, which currently covers only the first four seed_pool entries and never amihud_20 or volume_ratio_5_20. Expect operator:raw n=6, pass 12/12, duplicate_rate above the current 0.0909 because more seeds appear twice, and mean_abs_ic up iff the two new raw |IC| sum above 0.0274, the amount the two crossovers contribute now. Uncertainty: two crossover observations cannot separate 'composition is weak' from 'rank_minus is a weak composition operator'; if the slots are not reallocated the roster will keep 2 crossovers or fall below 12 candidates, which falsifies the reallocation premise. Note the prior builder returned an identical roster for crossover_pairs=4, but this roster actually shows 2 crossovers occupying slots, so the lever is live.
